item.title: Doxology to move to Plant Street
item.description: Doxology, currently located at 49 S. Main St., Winter Garden, will move to 16 E. Plant St., Winter Garden.

item.title: Play Street Museum opens in Winter Garden
item.description: The children's museum now is open from 8:30 a.m. to 6 p.m. Mondays through Fridays, located at 12107 Stoneybrook West Pkwy., Suite 104, Winter Garden.

item.title: Foundation Academy announces new president
item.description: Dr. Jeff Lawrence will be the new president. He previously served as the director of spiritual development.

item.title: FAMILIAR FACES: Jim Crescitelli is West Orange's history buff
item.description: Crescitelli, director of education with the Winter Garden Heritage Foundation, has long had a fascination with documenting history.

item.title: Ocoee PD warns of scam
item.description: The scam entails residents receiving text messages claiming to be official speeding violation notices.

item.title: Windermere announces road closures
item.description: Butler Street and Seventh Avenue will have daytime closures Monday, Feb. 9, through Friday, Feb. 13.

item.title: Two people found dead in Apopka store
item.description: The Apopka Police Department is investigating after finding two dead inside Griffin's General Store Friday, Feb. 6.

item.title: Vines by H. now is open at Restaurant Row
item.description: The restaurant is open from 4 to 11 p.m. Sundays through Thursdays, and 4 p.m. to midnight Fridays and Saturdays, and is located at 7533 W. Sand Lake Road, Orlando.

item.title: FIT AS FIRE soon to open in Hamlin
item.description: FIT AS FIRE is a reformer and hot mat pilates studio opening Friday, Feb. 27, at 16406 New Independence Parkway, Suite 110, Winter Garden.

item.title: West Orange high schoolers learn CPR from firefighters
item.description: Winter Garden Professional Firefighters Local 4947 taught CPR at West Orange Tuesday, Feb. 10.
